meta.note: Findings the user has NOT explicitly considered but DEV/Industry evidence suggests should be on the radar. HIGH=act now, MEDIUM=before module, LOW=consider.

findings.discovered_from: DEV JU_AutoCode has no TenantId  --  global counter per system
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: G2-003 Identity uses TenantId on every business table, but DEV-style numbering is system-wide. User may have implicitly assumed system-wide.
findings.evidence: DEV reverse-engineering shows 0 number patterns with tenant scope
findings.impact: Two tenants in same DB would collide on SO/PO numbers → production data corruption
findings.recommendation: Add TenantId (and CompanyId) to NumberSequence; re-test cross-tenant uniqueness

findings.discovered_from: DEV has JU_SysLog (operation) + JU_SysDesignLog (design)  --  separate tables
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: G2-002 IAuditWriter covers operation log. User may have missed the design-config audit need.
findings.evidence: DEV has 349 design log rows vs 177 op log  --  heavy config changes need separate channel
findings.impact: Lost traceability on dictionary/numbering/tax changes
findings.recommendation: Add IDesignAuditWriter to Foundation.G2-002 (next iteration). DEV pattern is good  --  KEEP.

findings.discovered_from: DEV has 0/151 JU_ tables with ms_description; GULIERP_CURRENT has no pg_description either
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: G2-001 PostgreSQL Engineering Standard may not mandate column comments.
findings.evidence: DEV reverse-engineering: ms_description=null on all 4006 columns
findings.impact: Schema documentation rots. New dev onboards slower.
findings.recommendation: Add architecture rule: every column has pg_description; CI check fails build if missing.

findings.topic: Number UNIQUE constraint at DB level
findings.discovered_from: DEV has no unique constraint on number fields (0 FK + 0 CHECK pattern)
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: NumberSequence application-level guard is implicit in POC-003. DB-level guard missing.
findings.evidence: DEV has 0 unique constraints documented (per size.json: only 1 default constraint)
findings.impact: Race condition: two concurrent inserts could create duplicate SO numbers
findings.recommendation: Add UNIQUE (TenantId, DocType, Year, Serial) at DB level.

findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: DEV uses single .NET default rounding. User may not have thought about per-type policy.
findings.evidence: JU_DataType has no rounding column; depends on .NET Math.Round default
findings.impact: Currency cross-aggregation loses 0.01 per sum → financial audit failure
findings.recommendation: Documented in semantic-data-type.json: AMOUNT/EXCHANGE_RATE=HALF_EVEN, QUANTITY=HALF_UP, RATE=HALF_EVEN.

findings.discovered_from: POC-002/POC-003 design (per G2-002 plan)
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: DEV has 22 inventory tables with manual "出库过账" step (anti-pattern).
findings.evidence: DEV: 出库过账/入库过账 are manual UI steps  --  leads to inconsistent inventory
findings.impact: Inventory balance ≠ sum of transactions; reconciliation nightmare
findings.recommendation: IInventoryService.PostAsync as single entry. ALL other modules emit GoodsReceiptConfirmed/ShipmentConfirmed events → listener calls PostAsync. NEVER direct write.

findings.discovered_from: DEV has 13 UOM but no dimension metadata
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: UOM is a flat list in DEV; user assumes same UOM works everywhere.
findings.evidence: DEV cannot catch bug: assigning kg item to m UOM
findings.impact: Cross-dimensional arithmetic bugs (e.g. unit price × kg) undetected
findings.recommendation: Uom.Dimension enum required. Item.BaseUomId (FK to Uom). Field metadata: BusinessSemanticType="QUANTITY" UomDimension="MASS" (Foundation contract).

findings.discovered_from: POC-002 InventoryBalance design
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: DEV status表 has 创建/已审核/已下单/已生产  --  workflow statuses, not inventory balances.
findings.evidence: DEV has 0 inventory balance states
findings.impact: Cannot block stock for QC; cannot show reserved vs available separately
findings.recommendation: InventoryBalance.{OnHand, Reserved, Available, PendingInspection, Blocked, Quarantined} as 5 separate decimal fields.

findings.discovered_from: DEV sample: 往来号=20001, 20002  --  pure numeric
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: User may have seen numeric codes as "natural"
findings.evidence: DEV has 4 BP types but no code prefix differentiation
findings.impact: Same number space for Customer (20001) and Supplier (20002)  --  no type visible in code
findings.recommendation: BP.Code: {TYPE_PREFIX}-{SERIAL}. CUST-001, SUPP-001, SUB-001, LOG-001.

findings.discovered_from: DEV has 克重 0.0 but no ExpiryDate
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: For non-pharma/食品 companies, expiry not needed. But tenant configurable.
findings.evidence: DEV no ExpiryDate field in any table
findings.impact: Cannot do FEFO for food/chem; cannot recall expired lot
findings.recommendation: InventoryLot.ExpiryDate nullable; Item.IsExpiryControlled bool; PickingStrategy enum (FIFO/FEFO/LIFO).

findings.discovered_from: G2-003 has gulierp_plant; IPlantScoped marker interface reserved
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Tenant/Company/Organization are obvious. Plant as ERP scope is less obvious.
findings.evidence: POC-001/002 used TenantId only. IPlantScoped not yet wired.
findings.impact: Multi-plant tenant cannot separate inventory per plant
findings.recommendation: Apply IPlantScoped to InventoryTransaction/InventoryBalance/ProductionOrder in their respective modules.

findings.topic: Field-level precision annotation as code attribute
findings.discovered_from: POC-003 has SalesOrderLine.UnitPrice decimal without precision attr
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: C# decimal type is unbounded; user may assume precision is implicit.
findings.evidence: G2-002 Foundation default is decimal(18,4); POC-003 not yet annotated
findings.impact: Generator cannot derive PG numeric(P,S) without manual map per field
findings.recommendation: [DecimalPrecision(20, 6)] attribute on C# decimal properties. Generator reads attribute → PG DDL. Already in MDM-000D contract draft.

findings.discovered_from: DEV: ReportStatus + LockStatus + WorkflowStatus  --  3 separate status fields on same entity
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Multi-status may seem flexible. But leads to ReportStatus=2 LockStatus=1 WorkflowStatus=3 (meaningless combinations).
findings.evidence: DEV: every template has 3 status fields. No consistency rules.
findings.impact: Untestable state combinations. Reports show inconsistent data.
findings.recommendation: Per G2-002 plan: 3D model DocumentStatus/ApprovalStatus/ExecutionStatus. NOT 3 fields on one entity. POC-003 already follows this.

findings.discovered_from: DEV: 品号=1000001 (pure numeric)
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Numeric codes feel "clean"
findings.evidence: DEV has 1 sample item with 1000001; no category prefix
findings.impact: Cannot identify item category from code; searching/sorting is hard
findings.recommendation: Item.Code: {CategoryCode}-{Sequence}. FG-000001, RM-000001, SF-000001.

findings.topic: Color / Material / Size as attribute, not UOM
findings.discovered_from: DEV sample: 商品表 has 材料 string but no Color
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: User may think of Color/Material as ItemCategory.
findings.evidence: DEV has no Color dimension in UOM
findings.impact: If treated as UOM, cross-color arithmetic bugs
findings.recommendation: Color/Material/Size/Grade are ItemAttribute, NOT UOM. Defer to SKU variant phase per P1-005 plan.

findings.discovered_from: DEV has JU_SysLog + JU_SysDesignLog  --  separate
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: One audit log seems enough; user may have missed the need for design-config audit specifically.
findings.evidence: 349 design log rows show config changes are frequent and need separate retention
findings.impact: Lost traceability on config changes
findings.recommendation: G2-002R2 may add IDesignAuditWriter. Per G2-002 plan, current IAuditWriter is for operations only.

findings.topic: Photo / Attachment as entity, not image column
findings.discovered_from: DEV: JU_TemplateFile.TemplateFile is image column (anti-pattern)
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: image column looks convenient
findings.evidence: DEV: image columns store base64 in DB; large payload slows backups
findings.impact: Backup size explosion, slow queries, no CDN, no access control
findings.recommendation: Attachment entity + object store (S3/MinIO). Reference by URL. Per G2-002-002 plan. REJECT image columns.

findings.discovered_from: DEV: no concept; some companies allow (WIP), others block
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: User may assume "block" is universal
findings.evidence: DEV has no field to indicate policy
findings.impact: One-size policy breaks manufacturing (WIP needs negative)
findings.recommendation: PlantPolicy.AllowNegativeStock bool. Default false.

findings.discovered_from: DEV: no concept
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Tenant may think their own calendar
findings.evidence: China 国务院 publishes yearly; companies follow with adjustments
findings.impact: Production planning off by 1-2 days per holiday
findings.recommendation: PublicHoliday table: CountryCode + Date + Name + IsWorkday. Defer to V2 Production.

findings.discovered_from: DEV no locale
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Default zh-CN assumed
findings.evidence: DEV has 14 users, no locale field
findings.impact: Multi-national tenant cannot have different display
findings.recommendation: Tenant.DefaultLocale + User.PreferredLocale.

findings.topic: Printed form number vs DB ID
findings.discovered_from: DEV: 编号 separate from RecordID
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: User may use DB ID as print number
findings.evidence: DEV: 单号 2511220018 vs RecordID 397/402  --  different sequences
findings.impact: Print number gaps confuse user; DB ID is implementation detail
findings.recommendation: DocumentNumber (business) separate from Id (technical). Already in POC-003.

findings.discovered_from: DEV: 状态表 has 删除/恢复 logic but not as separate entity
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Soft delete via Status flag seems enough
findings.evidence: DEV status values not fully enumerated
findings.impact: Cannot restore 30-day-old delete; no audit of who/when
findings.recommendation: SoftDelete entity with DeletedAt/DeletedBy/RestoredAt. Required for master data.

findings.discovered_from: G2-001/002/003 already use Code+Name pattern
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: DEV has 名称 + 备注 but no Code separation
findings.evidence: DEV: 商品表.品名 + 商品表.品号; but 字典 has only 名称 no Code
findings.impact: Code is implementation detail; Name is user-facing; mixing causes i18n issues
findings.recommendation: Every ReferenceData / MasterData has Code (technical, immutable) + Name (display, localizable) + Description (long text). Already in POC-002/003.

findings.discovered_from: DEV: no per-item flag
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Default to no-control simplifies
findings.evidence: DEV has 批次库存 view only
findings.impact: Cannot trace per-unit for recall; cannot enforce serialization for regulated items
findings.recommendation: Item.IsLotControlled, Item.IsSerialControlled, Item.IsExpiryControlled booleans.

findings.discovered_from: DEV: no cost method
findings.why_user_hasnt_considered: Default moving average assumed
findings.evidence: DEV no Item.CostMethod field
findings.impact: Cannot support Standard Cost (manufacturing) or FIFO (regulated)
findings.recommendation: Item.CostMethod enum: MOVING_AVERAGE (default) / STANDARD / FIFO. Per-Plant override possible.
